questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of role-playing scenarios in networking exercises?
Which of the following is an essential component of a strong introduction during networking?

correct_answer.text: Mentioning your name and a relevant detail

questions.question_text: When simulating a networking event, what is a recommended practice for participants?

correct_answer.text: To rotate partners and meet as many people as possible

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of setting personal networking goals?
What should you include in your networking journal to track progress effectively?

correct_answer.text: Names, contact information, and conversation notes
